name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
equipment: A bed or mat, comfortable clothing
instructions: Starting at your feet, tense each muscle group hard for about 5 seconds, then release and notice the relaxation that follows.
Work upward through your body -- calves, thighs, stomach, hands, arms, shoulders, face -- one group at a time.
Move slower than feels necessary; rushing defeats the point of noticing the tension-release contrast.
Follow tonight's bedtime yoga video as a physical complement to the muscle-relaxation sequence.
